scope: Read-only host pool control diagnosis and copy-helper classification. No compiler builds or source/canonical/Git changes.

shared_discriminator.name: Explicit equality of the full free-mask value
shared_discriminator.target_form: Copy descriptor to a scratch register, AND with 0x80000000, compare result with 0x80000000, then JNE for non-free.
shared_discriminator.candidate_form: if (descriptor & POOL_FREE) and if (next_descriptor & POOL_FREE), compiling to TEST and JE.
shared_discriminator.semantics: The predicates are identical for every unsigned 32-bit descriptor. This is a source-expression discriminator supported by three separate target sites, not a changed game predicate.
shared_discriminator.contrast_in_same_body: Allocation flags 0x10 and 0x20 use TEST AL,imm truth predicates at 0x459c/0x45ad; the target distinguishes those from the descriptor free predicate.

cfg_explanation.coalesce: Target 9 blocks versus candidate 7 does not imply two missing semantic cases. Explicit AND/CMP needs EDI for successor masked value; target pushes EDI only after the initial cursor<end guard and pops it only after the loop. The initial push block and conditional restore block account for the extra structural blocks.
cfg_explanation.loop: Both bodies already merge without advancing and otherwise advance to the next header, using the same final cursor<end condition. Do not add a new loop case or replay the rejected masked coalesce stride.
cfg_explanation.allocation: Target keeps a masked descriptor value for scan advancement at 0x4600 and uses a positive selected-block success body followed by failure epilogue. Candidate uses an early failure guard and the unmasked descriptor scaled by four. These are additional literal/control distinctions; the mask-equality family alone does not promise exact allocation CFG or full byte equality.
cfg_explanation.free: Target scans end-cell addresses until VA0xba29e0, with a found-body branch and direct out-of-pool return. Candidate bounds its pool-id counter to four, breaks, then checks pool-id again. Both encode the same observed range behavior; do not add casts or pointer placement to force its branch opcode.
cfg_explanation.initialize: Target computes/shifts its byte count after the diagnostic call; current source initializes a separate words local before that call, allowing earlier calculation. This is a subsequent parameter-lifetime question, outside the shared predicate experiment.

luna_family.prediction: Replacing only the three free truth predicates with ((value & POOL_FREE) == POOL_FREE) emits the target AND/CMP form. In coalesce this should create the target EDI scratch lifetime and its conditional save/restore, moving the 80-byte/7-block candidate toward the 96-byte/9-block target.
luna_family.falsifier: Fresh VC5 compilation still emits TEST, adds a new semantic case, changes any descriptor mutation or merge/advance behavior, or changes frozen save_arena bytes/ordered relocations or accepted diagnostic code. If falsified, stop rather than grid casts or truth spellings.
source_changes: In coalesce, use explicit full-mask equality for current descriptor and successor descriptor.
In allocate, use explicit full-mask equality for the scanned descriptor.
Retain flags0x10/0x20 truth tests, all existing loop/control bodies, request rounding, split/last-fit logic and pointer mutations.
luna_family.gate: Record a prediction before one fresh full-region compile; compare complete contributions including padding and all references. Existing semantic behavior must remain unchanged; raw equality alone grants FUNCTION_MATCH.
closed_peers: Frozen relocation-only-equal save_arena complete contribution and ordered relocations.
luna_family.not_replayed: The explicit masked coalesce stride family is exhausted; its failed variant added AND without solving the 80/96-byte discrepancy.

crt_copy_10fb0.classification: Positively identified as the historical Microsoft CRT memcpy/memmove shared implementation.
crt_copy_10fb0.identity_limit: Both public members have identical code; the original linked public symbol name cannot be distinguished. 46 internal absolute references were resolved in a diagnostic buffer only. This is library identification, not fresh source compilation or raw relocation-free acceptance.
crt_copy_10fb0.next_boundary: The identified text ends at0x112e5; target padding/next unrelated entry are outside the identified821-byte library member extent.
crt_copy_10fb0.abi: Three caller-cleaned dword arguments, destination/source/byte count. Entry compares destination and source ranges and selects overlap-safe forward/backward copying; byte tail tables are part of the library text.
crt_copy_10fb0.integrator_corroboration: work/copy_library/comparison.json and inspection.json independently corroborate pinned RTM LIBC/LIBCMT memcpy/memmove.

reverse_copy_43a0.classification: Evidence favors a project pool utility; no standard library-member identity established.
reverse_copy_43a0.boundary_proof: RET at0x444f, immediately followed by save_arena entry0x4450. No trailing NOPs or unresolved indirect branches in this span.
reverse_copy_43a0.abi: Three caller-cleaned dword arguments: destination, source, byte count. No return value is used by its only indexed direct caller0x495e.
reverse_copy_43a0.behavior: Computes (byte_count+3)>>2 using arithmetic SAR, copies that many whole dwords in descending order. Eight-dword groups are unrolled, followed by remaining words. It always copies backward and can copy rounded bytes beyond an unaligned byte count; no direction/overlap or byte-tail cases exist.
reverse_copy_43a0.provenance: Only indexed direct caller is the project pool compactor at0x495e; the function immediately precedes the pool configuration region. This plus its restricted rounding/direction differs from the positively identified CRT body. Adjacency and one caller support a project hypothesis, not proven original TU.
reverse_copy_43a0.lifecycle_limit: Do not replace with modern byte-count memcpy/memmove or invent a safety fix. For its actual compactor call, verify the request is a whole-block dword multiple and destination moves upward. Signed formal count type remains inferred from SAR; exact original prototype is unknown.
